panels.description: Ctrl+click a legend label to remove just that series (click again to restore). Plain click isolates it instead. | glm53-flash (n+s): non-stream + stream combined. Stream rows use real generation window (endTime - completionStartTime). Non-stream rows are APPROXIMATED with a fixed TTFT of 1 s: generation = E2E - 1 s, TPOT = (E2E - 1 s) / completion_tokens. All other series remain streaming-only.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $bucket), CASE WHEN model_group IN ('glm52', 'glm5.1-w8a8', 'glm53', 'glm5.1') THEN 'glm-text' WHEN model_group IN ('deepseek-v4-flash', 'deepseek-v4-flash0731') THEN 'deepseek-v4-flash' WHEN model_group = 'glm53-flash' THEN 'glm53-flash(s)' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group, ''), '<none>') END AS metric, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "completionStartTime")) * 1000 / NULLIF(completion_tokens, 0))::numeric, 1) AS tpot_ms FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND status = 'success' AND "completionStartTime" > "startTime" AND proxy_server_request->>'stream' = 'true' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "completionStartTime")) >= 1 AND completion_tokens > 0 AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias("startTime", $bucket),
  'glm53-flash (n+s)' AS metric,
  ROUND(AVG(
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(proxy_server_request->>'stream','false') <> 'true'
        THEN (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "startTime")) * 1000 - 1000) / NULLIF(completion_tokens, 0)
      ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "completionStartTime")) * 1000 / NULLIF(completion_tokens, 0)
    END
  )::numeric, 1) AS tpot_ms
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime")
  AND status = 'success'
  AND model_group = 'glm53-flash'
  AND "endTime" > "startTime"
  AND completion_tokens > 0
  AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})
  AND (
    (COALESCE(proxy_server_request->>'stream','false') <> 'true'
       AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "startTime")) * 1000 > 1000)
    OR (proxy_server_request->>'stream' = 'true'
       AND "completionStartTime" > "startTime"
       AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("endTime" - "completionStartTime")) >= 1)
  )
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.description: Hour of day in Asia/Riyadh local time (startTime is stored UTC; converted +3h). Buckets are hour-of-day across the whole selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  LPAD(h.hr::text, 2, '0') AS hour,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = 'glm-text') AS "glm-text",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = 'deepseek-v4-flash') AS "deepseek-v4-flash",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = 'glm53-flash') AS "glm53-flash",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = '<none>') AS "<none>"
FROM generate_series(0, 23) AS h(hr)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT "startTime", CASE WHEN model_group IN ('glm52','glm5.1-w8a8','glm53','glm5.1') THEN 'glm-text' WHEN model_group IN ('deepseek-v4-flash','deepseek-v4-flash0731') THEN 'deepseek-v4-flash' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group,''),'<none>') END AS grp
  FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
  WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})
) s ON EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (s."startTime" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh'))::int = h.hr
GROUP BY h.hr
ORDER BY h.hr

panels.description: Hour of day in Asia/Riyadh local time (startTime is stored UTC; converted +3h). Buckets are hour-of-day across the whole selected time range.

SELECT
  LPAD(h.hr::text, 2, '0') AS hour,
  COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(s.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = 'glm-text')), 0) AS "glm-text",
  COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(s.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = 'deepseek-v4-flash')), 0) AS "deepseek-v4-flash",
  COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(s.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = 'glm53-flash')), 0) AS "glm53-flash",
  COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(s.total_tokens) FILTER (WHERE s.grp = '<none>')), 0) AS "<none>"
FROM generate_series(0, 23) AS h(hr)
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT "startTime", total_tokens, CASE WHEN model_group IN ('glm52','glm5.1-w8a8','glm53','glm5.1') THEN 'glm-text' WHEN model_group IN ('deepseek-v4-flash','deepseek-v4-flash0731') THEN 'deepseek-v4-flash' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(model_group,''),'<none>') END AS grp
  FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs"
  WHERE $__timeFilter("startTime") AND api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})
) s ON EXTRACT(HOUR FROM (s."startTime" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Riyadh'))::int = h.hr
GROUP BY h.hr
ORDER BY h.hr

panels.description: Bar trend of glm53-flash requests split by content: 'with image' = request contains image_url parts in proxy_server_request.messages; 'text only' = no images. Scope: selected time range + key group, glm53-flash only. Bucket: $bucket.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(s."startTime", $bucket),
  CASE WHEN ic.imgs > 0 THEN 'with image' ELSE 'text only' END AS metric,
  COUNT(*) AS requests
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) AS imgs
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.proxy_server_request->'messages')='array'
         THEN s.proxy_server_request->'messages' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(m->'content')='array' THEN m->'content' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) c
  WHERE c->>'type'='image_url'
) ic
WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
  AND s.api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})
  AND s.model_group = 'glm53-flash'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.description: All glm53-flash requests containing image_url parts in the request. image_count = number of image parts parsed from messages. Image-specific token counts are not reported upstream (prompt_tokens_details.image_tokens is null), so input/output tokens are the request totals.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  s."startTime" AS time,
  s.request_id,
  s.metadata->>'user_api_key_alias' AS key_alias,
  s.model_group,
  s.status,
  s.prompt_tokens AS input_tokens,
  s.completion_tokens AS output_tokens,
  ic.imgs AS image_count,
  LEFT(COALESCE(s.metadata->'error_information'->>'error_message','-'),60) AS error
FROM "LiteLLM_SpendLogs" s
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT count(*) AS imgs
  FROM jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.proxy_server_request->'messages')='array'
         THEN s.proxy_server_request->'messages' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) m
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(m->'content')='array' THEN m->'content' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) c
  WHERE c->>'type'='image_url'
) ic
WHERE $__timeFilter(s."startTime")
  AND s.api_key IN (${key_group:sqlstring})
  AND s.model_group = 'glm53-flash'
  AND ic.imgs > 0
ORDER BY s."startTime" DESC
LIMIT 500
